verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own architecture page claims "versioned state" ([openclaw-docs-111]), and the skills CLI lists install-from-Git, update, and verify operations ([openclaw-docs-55], [openclaw-docs-82]). That gives thin first-party support for versioning agent behavior. The Automations scheduler docs ([openclaw-docs-27]) only say jobs are persisted, with nothing on version history, change review, or rollback for scheduled jobs. Missing for 10: documented version history for automations/cron jobs, a review or diff step before changes take effect, explicit rollback commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
